title: Anomaly Detection Across 5G Slices Using Federated Learning
summary: IIT Hyderabad is implementing federated anomaly detection using network emulators, aiming to improve 5G security and service resilience.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The system is being developed with open-source network tools. It is intended to identify anomalies while preserving distributed data handling. No operational attack interception, prevented loss, or measured service improvement is reported.
purpose: Detect network anomalies across distributed 5G slices.
system: Anomaly Detection Across 5G Slices Using Federated Learning

ratings.reason: Federated anomaly detection is in implementation using network emulators; no operational threat interception is documented.
Cybersecurity and uninterrupted public services are intended effects.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 17: Anomaly Detection Across 5G Slices Using Federated Learning

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.
